name: Replika
long_description:
Luka is a software development company based in San Francisco, California.

The company created Luka app, a new messenger with AI-powered chatbots. They help you find places to eat, do web search, make plans together, pick places to eat, play trivia games and lots of other things in a messenger.

In 2016 Luka launched a closed testing of Replika, a new app that allows to create a personal AI friend that helps people deal with loneliness. The app is powered by a proprietary deep learning architecture.
one_liner: Replika is an AI friend that you can talk to designed to make you…

name: Mindset Health
long_description: We help healthcare providers treat their gastrointestinal patients with AI-delivered therapy. Using machine learning and large language models, we learn from therapy data, outcomes, and physiology to deliver adaptive, scalable treatments for conditions like IBS - without the waitlist.
one_liner: Building AI therapeutics for physical health conditions like IBS.

name: DocVita
long_description:
We make it easy for anyone in India to access healthcare over Zoom, Meet, or WhatsApp. We provide care in 11 local languages.

For every appointment, we provide a concierge who manages all logistics for the patient & handles the back-office work for doctors. With this, we have cracked the code to make telehealth work in India.

name: Synapticure
long_description:
Personalized virtual clinical care is finally here for neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and related Dementias (Cognitive), Parkinson's and Huntington's (Movement), and ALS (Motor neuron).

We provide a novel approach to care in these diseases, centering a patient and caregiver around a coordinator who quarterbacks patients through our full Multi-Disciplinary Care Resources to local aid, PT/OT and home health support. When you leave our clinic, it's not with a handful of paper referrals, but with our coordinators helping you book and find the best physicians, DME, trials, and even cheapest prescriptions. We are devoted to helping patients, from guidance on care and insurance to providing the full spectrum of investigational and clinical testing to improve outcomes. 

Synapticure was built by leading patient and caregiver advocates alongside leading  clinicians, biotech executives and telemedicine executives to bring the neurodegenerative disease care and treatment experience into the 21st century, and is backed by the leading Venture funds and investors in the remote health and life sciences space.
one_liner: We deliver personalized medicine for neurodegenerative  patients

name: Gilgamesh Pharmaceuticals
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA; Remote
long_description: Gilgamesh is a pioneering, clinical stage mental health science-focused biotechnology company. We have a disciplined focus on developing innovative new chemical entities (NCEs) leveraging a unique combination of medicinal chemistry, intellectual property strategy, neuroscience & neurobiology, and drug development expertise. We are an experienced team, with proven success in biotech exits and inventions.
one_liner: Gilgamesh Pharmaceuticals, a Clinical stage biotechnology company…

name: Legion Health
long_description: Legion Health is building autonomous medical care, starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—entirely shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

name: Intellect
long_description:
Intellect is the global leader in hyperlocalised mental healthcare, serving 4 million lives across enterprise employers, insurers, healthcare systems, and governments in over 50 languages and 100 countries.

With a comprehensive, AI-powered care ecosystem, Intellect seamlessly integrates digital therapeutics, virtual therapy, high-acuity crisis support, and specialty clinical treatment - delivered through its proprietary digital platforms and directly owned mental health clinics.

Headquartered in Singapore with nine global offices, Intellect is backed by top investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures, and HOF Capital. It is trusted by hundreds of Fortune 500 companies and industry leading organisations.
one_liner: A modern-day mental healthcare company for global workforces.

name: Perspectives Health
long_description:
America is facing an addiction and mental health crisis, but the treatment programs trying to solve the problem are faced with administrative burden, staff shortages, and pressure from payers. 

We work with treatment programs to incorporate AI that reduces administrative burden, prevents insurance denials, and helps directors run their program better.

Our agents analyze charts to prevent insurance denials, complete documentation and insurance paperwork to save staff time, and sift through historical data to find opportunities for improvement.
one_liner: AI to run behavioral health programs better

name: Allia Health
long_description:
Allia is the first AI-native clinical group for behavioral health. We bring hundreds of independent practices across all 50 states into one national group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale.

Nearly 1,000 therapy and psychiatry practices already run on our free platform, supporting >300,000 patients and nearly 1 million monthly visits. That's our wedge. We activate high-performing practices into our medical group, which now spans ~600 providers and ~70 sites, in-person in 32 states and telehealth in all 50 — with signed contracts with the country's largest health insurance payers.

Behavioral health is the largest part of healthcare no one has organized: unmeasured, buried in admin, and fragmented across tiny practices. Being one clinically integrated group, powered by a single-instance OS (EHR, CRM, and RCM in one), is what makes care measurable, accountable, and coordinated — efficiently and at scale.
one_liner: Clinically Integrated Group for Mental Health
